about_the_game:
Welcome to the World of "Limbo Break"

"Limbo Break" is a general-audience infinite flow text adventure game. You play as Jiang Yuejiao, who flees to the neighboring country of Dipa after being framed, only to find yourself navigating different horror worlds through multiple rounds of evidence collection and decision-making that will shape both your fate and others'.

Infinite Flow: A survival game leaping through different horror worlds, where mere survival isn't the only key to escaping the alternate reality.

A Journey Without End

As Jiang Yuejiao, your escape to the foreign land of Dipa proves futile when a supernatural encounter drags you into bizarre worlds—each filled with deadly secrets and unknown horrors. Behind it all lies a deeper truth waiting to be uncovered...

When the line between reality and illusion shatters, are you the player in this game, or have you unwittingly become the prey?

Explore five distinct horror-themed worlds, each focusing on one central character. Your choices will determine your and your partner’s fate—face irreversible loss, or remain trapped together forever. The possibilities are endless.

Survive, cooperate with your partner, and fight your way back to reality.

Don't Just Be Scared

Never dismiss any eerie event outright—it might hide clues crucial to your escape. As clues accumulate, moments of insight will reveal key solutions!

Every scene may conceal vital hints, so investigate every prompt thoroughly.

All collected information and clues can be reviewed on the Clues Wall.

Piece everything together, deduce logically, and uncover the truth.

Gather evidence, obtain clues, organize your thoughts—then solve the puzzles and expose the worlds’ buried secrets.

Your Choices, Your Endings

This infinite flow world is yours to command—the power of choice belongs to you.

Even without conquering every world, you can still return to reality, confront the final truth, and make your ultimate decision.
